item.title: langchain-core 1.8.0 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: **`langchain-core` 1.8.0 drops support for Python 3.10**, which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve `langchain-core` 1.7.x. Release notes: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/releases/tag/langchain-core%3D%3D1.8.0
